newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures end mostly lower.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures end mostly lower.

text.p: Sep 5 - Most IMM currency futures finished down, held back by losses in Sept yen as the dollar firmed. Trade seen mostly consolidative ahead of Aug U.S. jobs report due Fri at 0730 CDT/1230 GMT. Jobs seen up 244,000 compared with 193,000 in July. Sept Canada slides on technicals, trade there brisk. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
